name: Hotel battery 6SnP 21700
note: avionics + payload + bay heater; mass and cost carried by the sizing model; 6S2P/6S3P is the Ukrainian field-pack format

name: Power module + battery monitor
part: Matek FCHUB-12S / generic 60 A hall sensor
note: voltage and current sense to the autopilot

name: 5 V 5 A switching regulator
note: losses only; load is on the consumers

name: Flight controller
alternate: SpeedyBee F405 WING (no CAN: PWM-over-spine variant)
note: ArduPilot; chosen over the F405 for its CAN port, which is what makes the stern pod a two-wire module; onboard SPL06 barometer is not rated below 300 hPa so BARO is primary

name: External barometer 10-1200 mbar
note: the only common MEMS barometer rated to 10 mbar (31 km); BMP388/390 and SPL06 stop near 9 km

name: GNSS + compass
note: airborne <1g dynamic model: valid to 80 km; must be set or the fix drops near 12 km; sits under a foam cap on the bay lid for warmth

name: Companion computer (ROS 2)
note: Pi list prices were unstable through 2026; any arm64 Linux SBC with one UART works

name: C2 + telemetry radio (air)
part: mLRS 868/915 MHz 1 W module (MatekSys mR900-30 class)
note: 1 W symmetric MAVLink link: the link budget gives a 100 mW ELRS receiver only ~130 km with margin and the vehicle drifts ~100 km; band is a swap-in module decision

name: C2 antenna 868/915 MHz
note: nadir-pointing pattern; see link budget

name: Motor controller 6S 40 A
note: in the stern pod next to its own pack: no high-current lead runs the spine

name: Propulsion motor
note: power carried by the sizing model; bearings regreased with low-temperature grease

name: Propeller
note: slow thin-air propeller; folding protects it in the flaccid launch chain

name: Gimbal yaw servo
note: cold: degrease and re-lubricate; fed from the pod regulator

name: Gimbal pitch servo
note: doubles as vertical trim

name: Ballast dispenser servo
note: steel-shot hopper; never water

name: Bay heater
part: Polyimide film heater 10 W + MOSFET switch
note: thermostat on FC relay output; average from the bay thermal model

name: Stern pod heater
note: keeps gimbal servos and the propulsion pack above -20 C

name: Ambient temperature probe
note: DS18B20 stops at -55 C and the tropopause does not; RTD is passive and read by RTD_A in the bay

name: Gas temperature probe
part: PT1000 thin-film RTD on 2 m lead
note: inside the fill neck: measures superheat directly

name: Bay temperature probe
note: thermostat feedback; the one place a DS18B20 is inside its rating

name: Hull differential pressure
note: I2C 0x25; tube to hull; the hull is a 20-60 Pa vessel so this is the structural sensor

name: Airspeed pitot
note: I2C 0x26; q is 1.6 Pa at 6 m/s so only a 125 Pa-class sensor resolves it

name: Anti-collision strobe
note: required below 60 000 ft at night under Part 101 Subpart D; not fitted for day flights; needs a cold-rated driver before it is

name: Flight termination unit
part: LilyGO T-Beam Supreme (ESP32-S3 + SX1262 + u-blox M10)
note: independent processor + GNSS + radio; runs guidance.Geofence

name: FTU primary battery
note: primary lithium: rated to -40 C and never shares a rail with any main pack; 2P so both cutters can fire together

name: FTU barometer
note: second altitude source independent of the autopilot

name: Cut-down A (suspension)
note: separates the equipment string from the cells; passive wire outside, MOSFET inside the FTU box

name: Cut-down B (envelope)
part: Nichrome hot-wire on rip panel + MOSFET
note: opens the cell: second independent termination; passive wire outside, MOSFET inside the FTU box

name: Recovery parachute 1.2 m
note: sized for 6 m/s at sea level under the equipment string; mass carried by the sizing model

name: Radar reflector
note: required by Part 101 Subpart D

name: Satellite tracker (option)
note: beyond-horizon position; airtime extra

name: Digital video downlink (option)
note: payload bay item not part of the vehicle

name: Broadband backhaul (option)
note: 1.1 kg and 25-40 W: an S4 payload not an S1 one

name: RTD amplifier (ambient)
note: SPI to the companion

name: Propulsion battery 6SnP 21700
note: its own pack in the pod: losing propulsion power cannot brown out the autopilot; mass carried by the sizing model

name: Pod 5 V 3 A regulator
note: servos and pod node powered locally

name: Pod CAN node
note: DroneCAN: turns three PWM runs and two sense lines into one twisted pair; the pod becomes a swap-in module on one connector
